verdict.rationale: Mercury ships duplicate-bill detection and an AI assistant (Command) that can answer spend questions and clear categorization backlog, which are adjacent building blocks, but there is no documented anomaly-detection or pre-close audit workflow, and the MCP layer needed for agents to autonomously monitor and flag issues is explicitly described as 'soon' (not yet shipped). Missing for 10: dedicated ledger anomaly/duplicate-transaction detection beyond bill pay, an explicit pre-close review/flagging workflow, and a shipped (not planned) agent/MCP integration for autonomous monitoring.
